design_principle: Ambiguous voice wording is resolved by the risk policy only after the scene evidence is visible. The route contains no U-turn because that maneuver is unsafe on an urban expressway.

scene_profile.weather: HardRainNoon adapted to night lighting, wet road, fog, and reduced visibility
scene_profile.road_form: urban expressway transitioning into a work zone with a closing right lane
scene_profile.visibility: low light, rain reflection, fog occlusion
scene_profile.voice_input: voice commands with controlled environmental-noise variants

required_topology: right-lane closure taper created by cones between 1800 m and 2400 m
two-lane narrowed work zone from 2400 m to 4300 m
work-zone exit and normal-lane recovery before the finish
no legal U-turn or ordinary intersection maneuver within the route

segments.purpose: ambiguous safe-speed command and sudden cut-in

segments.topology: advance work-zone signs and cone taper

segments.purpose: pedestrian, work vehicle, and conditional avoidance

voice_command_schedule.spoken_text: 前方路况危险，保持安全车速。

scene_binding.policy_resolution: Risk policy selects a speed in the configured 35--45 km/h band.

voice_command_schedule.spoken_text: 能见度差，保持右侧车道，车速不高于40公里每小时。
突发车辆加塞，紧急避让。
施工路段，减速并道至左侧车道。
看到锥形桶和临时横穿行人，保持低速，必要时停车。
前方施工车辆占道，左侧安全时绕行，否则停车等待。
驶离施工路段后，保持安全速度行驶至终点。

special_events.behavior: Rain, night lighting, wet-road reflection, and fog are active throughout. Camera exposure and noise should be fixed per test seed.
Vehicle enters the ego lane from the left at a closing distance that is recoverable by braking; it must not create an unavoidable collision.
Warning signs appear before any cone blocks a lane.
Cones appear progressively every 18--25 m, moving from the right lane edge toward the lane center, then close the right lane by 2400 m.
A work truck occupies the closed lane and displays a left-merge cue; the remaining lane width is visibly reduced.
A worker starts behind the barrier, becomes visible near the taper, and crosses only after the ego has a recoverable stopping distance.
Maintenance vehicle partially blocks the active lane. The left gap is initially unsafe, then becomes safe after a short wait, exercising the conditional command.
Cones end and normal lane markings return before the final command is announced.

evaluation_protocol.offline_utterance_set: At least 10 paraphrases per template under clean audio and at least 3 controlled noise levels. Evaluate whether ambiguity is preserved for risk-policy resolution rather than invented by the parser.
